Down In The Hole
Home » Statistical Information » Songs » Songs =- D -= » Down In The Hole

Track 5 of High Hopes, 2014.

  • Credits
  • Performances
  • Released on Album
  • On The Tracks
  • Lyrics
  • High Hopes (2014)
    • Bruce Springsteen: vocals, guitar, banjo, percussion
    • Clarence Clemons: tenor saxophone
    • Danny Federici: organ
    • Patti Scialfa: backing vocals
    • Evan Springsteen: backing vocals
    • Jessica Springsteen: backing vocals
    • Sam Springsteen: backing vocals
    • Garry Tallent: bass
    • Soozie Tyrell: violin
    • Max Weinberg: drums

Performed live 0 times (not including snippet performances).

Released on High Hopes (2014).

DOWN IN THE HOLE - V1 uncirculating
DOWN IN THE HOLE - V2 4:59 HOPES

Note: Springsteen confirmed in a December 2013 Rolling Stone interview that "Down In The Hole" V1 was recorded during sessions for The Rising. V2 is from 2013 and was issued on 2014's High Hopes; the 2002 base track was used, with the later addition of overdubs. Produced by Brendan O'Brien and featuring Clarence Clemons on tenor saxophone and Danny Federici on organ.

Studio Sessions: The Rising
